_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : CET1 (solvabilite cle banque GSIB), Consumer Banking Rev (segment principal), Global Markets Rev, NII total (signal taux), GWIM AUM proxy.

kpis.signal: Solidite capital BAC ~12%, marge confortable vs minimum reglementaire ~10.7%
kpis.description_fr: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio (Standardized approach). KPI cle solvabilite banque GSIB. Marge sur minimum reglementaire (~10.7% avec SCB).
kpis.description_en: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio (Standardized approach). Key GSIB solvency metric. Buffer over regulatory minimum (~10.7% with SCB).

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment BAC, expose taux et qualite credit consumer
kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Consumer Banking (deposits + consumer lending). Plus gros segment BAC. Total revenue net of interest expense.
kpis.description_en: Consumer Banking segment revenue (deposits + consumer lending). BAC largest segment. Total revenue net of interest expense.

kpis.signal: Trading et banque investissement, croissance solide 2024 driven equity & banking fees
kpis.description_fr: Revenus Global Markets (trading FICC/Equities + investment banking + brokerage). Volatilite mais marges elevees.
kpis.description_en: Global Markets revenue (FICC/Equities trading + investment banking + brokerage). Volatile but high-margin.

kpis.signal: NII en plateau 2024 (taux Fed eleves + reprices de depot)
kpis.description_fr: Net Interest Income consolide. Indicateur principal sensibilite aux taux Fed. Pic Q4 FY23 puis stabilisation 2024.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated Net Interest Income. Key Fed rate sensitivity indicator. Peaked Q4 FY23 then stabilized in 2024.

kpis.signal: Reprise IB fees +31% YoY (M&A et ECM revival 2024) apres creux 2022-2023
kpis.description_fr: Commissions banque d'investissement consolidees (DCM, ECM, M&A). Cyclique. Pic FY21 ($8.9Mds) puis creux 2022-23, rebond FY24.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated investment banking fees (DCM, ECM, M&A). Cyclical. Peak FY21 ($8.9B) then 2022-23 trough, FY24 rebound.

_notes: Source : 10-K BAC FY20-FY24 SEC EDGAR. Consumer Banking + Global Markets segment data.
